## Verified fix — closing directly after important checks and source/result review

Implemented at **63d1004a851abc92e00c90a9deeff083a1038c9e** on `development/preview-hardening`.

- Complete, verbatim MIT permission/copyright (**Copyright 2016 Vladimir Kharlampidi**) and canonical provenance now accompany every copied Compose font bundle. A build guard rejects changed font bytes, missing/modified MIT text or stale resource copies.
- Actual inspection exposed an additional owning cause: Android resources were enabled only when a module had instrumentation tests, so the icon AAR omitted its font entirely. Production Compose/Android resource ownership now enables packaging independently; no test host was added merely to mask it.
- **Seven fresh built archives accepted:** Desktop JAR; Android AAR; iOS device, iOS simulator, JS and Wasm resource ZIPs; canonical companion-notices ZIP. All six font-bearing outputs contain the retained generated resource path, exact font SHA256 `67c44fe9183b002e79dde7f6977e2988661c9a3e4a3c5fce968787efdbed823c`, complete MIT SHA256 `310d6ab6483280280c9db122bded0a63c09558bc5743720f61dbcbb494db370a`, and byte-identical reviewed provenance. CRCs and actual archive entries were inspected without extraction. Build exited **0 in 56.02 seconds** (the machine receipt is authoritative for precise elapsed time).
- Artifact-verifier fixtures **73/73**, including six focused font-distribution regressions; catalogue checks **9/9**, with all 1,322 constants, 1,234 glyph mappings and 6,984 system-name strings retained. These Python methods are tooling checks, not platform runtime tests.
- Documentation explicitly distinguishes the Flutter Cupertino font from Apple's system SF Symbols. The legacy filename/public generated-resource identity remains for compatibility.

All three original acceptance criteria and immutable source/results were reviewed. Font-free compiler KLIBs are not rewritten: the canonical companion-notices ZIP remains attached to every Maven publication, and Apple/browser font resource archives carry their own notices. Full packaged-consumer/native-runtime/ABI verification and unrelated dependency/legal/security/release gates remain separate and **are not certified by this closure**. No packages, releases or deployments were published.

Preserved the original five font-bearing resource-bundle notice gaps and the font-free Android AAR observation. Detailed evidence will be committed immediately after this direct closure, rather than delaying closure for documentation.
